trust_decision.summary: _defu decides which caller-supplied keys may land on the merged result: base-object keys are filtered by a __proto__/constructor skip, but the defaults object is shallow-copied with Object.assign, which invokes the __proto__ setter for an own '__proto__' key (e.g. from JSON.parse) and replaces the result's prototype.

landing_point.why: The summary names __proto__ in the defaults argument; _defu in the only source file has a single line that copies defaults, directly above the existing __proto__ key skip.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API defu()/defuFn()/defuArrayFn()/createDefu(merger)() exported from src/defu.ts:45-69 (CJS re-export lib/defu.cjs:1-10); every argument reaches _defu as `defaults` via reduce at src/defu.ts:48, nested objects via recursion at src/defu.ts:30-35

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No separate site exists to dismiss; the only nearby route (base-object keys) is already guarded at src/defu.ts:13, so a solver can only plausibly argue the existing guard suffices, which the report contradicts.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Defaults objects must keep their ordinary keys and values, including null-prototype objects and ES Module namespace objects that isPlainObject accepts; 'constructor' as a nested plain key is skipped only in base. A fix that rejects/throws on any defaults object containing '__proto__', or that filters 'constructor' from defaults too, would change documented merge results.

O6_input_shapes: own '__proto__' key on a top-level defaults argument (JSON.parse-produced)
same key on nested defaults objects, reached through recursion at src/defu.ts:30-35 into the same line
any argument position, since reduce at src/defu.ts:48 passes each argument as defaults

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A built-in merger (like defuFn/defuArrayFn at src/defu.ts:56-69) that copies keys of a function's return value onto object with Object.assign or for-in assignment
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mergers already write object[key] directly; a maintainer adding an 'object-merge' helper merger would naturally reuse Object.assign.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An object-valued branch that shallow-copies a non-plain-but-accepted value (e.g. Module namespace) with Object.assign before recursion
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: isPlainObject at src/_utils.ts:21-22 already special-cases Module objects, a plausible place to add a normalising copy.

O9_family: prototype pollution / prototype injection (CWE-1321) via Object.assign __proto__ setter on defaults copy

O10_build.project_tests: test/defu.test.ts:104-111 'should not override Object prototype' (vitest); test/utils.test.ts for isPlainObject

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a '__proto__' key check on defaults or replace Object.assign with spread / null-prototype copy — which is the published fix itself, so the obvious fix is also complete.

out_of_scope_notes: After the fix the result can carry an own '__proto__' data property, which a downstream Object.assign by a consumer would re-interpret; outside this repository's code.
